name: napalm-coherent-multi-getter-operational-0455
instr:
Give NAPALM callers a coherent snapshot of several operational getters, preserving caller order, individual failures, and established normalized values across vendor transports. The captured observations must be reusable for compliance validation and deterministic command-line JSON without querying the device again.

A nonempty `SnapshotRequest` accepts ordered `SnapshotCall` entries with keyword arguments; empty identities, empty getter names, duplicate names, and empty requests raise `InvalidSnapshotRequest`, a `ValueError`, before acquisition. Collection preserves request order across EOS, IOS, IOS-XR XML-agent, IOS-XR NETCONF, Junos, and NX-OS, while `SnapshotPolicy.stop_on_error` prevents all later transport work. Unsupported or unimplemented getters produce `UNSUPPORTED`, other exceptions produce `FAILED` with `SnapshotFailure`, and continuation never disguises failures or suppresses later successes. Successful values are detached from mutable driver responses, retain each direct getter's normalization, and round-trip deterministically through `SnapshotResult.to_dict(self)` and `SnapshotResult.from_dict(cls, value)`; `SnapshotResult.outcome_for(self, name)` resolves caller identities. `validate_snapshot(snapshot, validation_source)` consumes each successful value once, reports failed or unsupported observations as skipped, and preserves existing comparison results without reacquisition. `SnapshotValidationResult.to_dict(self)` and snapshot-backed CLI output keep acquisi
